## Design

### 2026-10-12 – Initial design has been started.

**2h**

Initial design has been started.

Firstly I wanted to get some ideas for the organizer, so I just searched some stuff up to get some references. I really liked some of the examples that used wooden dowels, so I figured why not do that. I looked for some dowels on amazon and found a good set. They're 12" long, which is a good size for my table. Then I started modeling the first part of the organizer. I want two shelves, so I just made a side pieces for the dowels to slot into since the dowels will end up acting as the shelves.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 181302](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/519ece5976d7999d9f30954167621460ea6b07435a0d89241d59e0d54725a98b.png)

I then put it together in an assembly and it looks pretty cool so far.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 181248](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/221aebfbf2c20e935505edbadd360ff1e066e92d537137eae6d0511cb939b0c3.png)

Then I realized that if I'm putting my keys on the shelf then its going to be difficult because of the gaps, so I made a small attachment that can just clip on to the dowels.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 183256](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/8f4c9e7cfb26e4c189c7a83ed46bd1d3b1802a3ce9d48fce665ce31cc521c976.png)

I thought some more about what I wanted the final result to look like, so I'm probably going to replace one of the side pieces with an L shaped connector to have an L shaped organizer that fits on the corner of my desk.

### 2026-10-18 – Finished the design

**7h**

Finished the design

I started working on the next part of the organizer, which is where it goes in the L shape. I played around with some ideas, starting with maybe having another block that could connect to the first part of the organizer.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 133208](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/4e7c4d2b3189ff9e30e7937f929a7ebedb088f2aae512c63e464afa1c691c1a3.png)

I didn't really like how that looked though, so instead I spent some more time thinking and playing around with it before making an arc, which I really liked.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 133131](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/6edcfdf970d78c8ee21ae267ba10cffd6439c45c197644a2fdfeffa6082df5b8.png)

It may not look like much but it embarrassingly took me a while to get to this point. The problem with this though is that the top wouldn't really be that sturdy, especially in the middle of the curve as there's nothing supporting it, so I made a simple support piece that just acts as a structural column.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 133556](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/338dddd70ae57835cd17039fb761d89c7760f720edbd4592b01b7f45b0dd7cc5.png)

I put all of these into the assembly and it turned out looking pretty good.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 133602](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/70aa259cc13796adcec9bc106e711d8f33de2e570c13aee505d823acc02057ff.png)

For the next part I wanted some more shelving, but in kind of a drawer style, so I just made a box with extrusions in the back that would slot into the circular pieces.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 140046](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/25a9c80f9db56fd55c5038f11f9606d3555695769ac8ca510c3615d64d500641.png)

I added shelves into the drawer by extruding out the shape. I tried using the shell tool, but I messed it up multiple times, so I guess I still need more practice with that.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 140304](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/98b94e84ff54ceea4e24e08d86ac0626294506768468657438ed2907b6d89333.png)

I put the box into the assembly as well, and that's it for the design.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 140342](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/4d491e9118569d5bd95fee6aeba002334a3bfe33bdd7ce89041a2d4129aa7448.png)

Before wrapping up, I thought about how this would be when its on my desk and how it would probably slide around a lot, so I found some rubber feet off amazon and put them in the BOM. I can just attach these to the bottom of the organizer and it should be good.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 141822](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cVf1AKGAA4bfEud82NdRBGOmHvDBJZX3/9646e24a6bc9a2b405d3adad04ec18660b67796db63ee1d9dd04ed615db76d8e.png)

I also put the files into the repo for both the model and the printable, so that should be everything completed.
